changelog.title: IT Support Roleplay Lab Redesign
changelog.description: Roleplay lab expanded to 10 scenarios with interactive role selection (User, Tech, Instructor). Covers BSOD, malware, printer, account lockout, slow startup, VPN, and browser hijacking alongside the original 3.

changelog.title: WSA M09 DHCP Tree Fix
changelog.description: Server and IPv4 tree nodes now stay expanded after scope operations. Task 8 hint updated to guide users to Server Options node.

changelog.title: Platform-Wide XP Attribution
changelog.description: All labs, quizzes, and presentations now write earned XP to the central hexworth_xp system. 11 vault labs, 31 CLH labs, Shield bootcamp, and Key cryptography all fixed. One-time flags prevent double-awarding.

changelog.title: Edition Selector Back Button Fix
changelog.description: Windows Edition Selector tool back button now returns to Core 2 index instead of broken dashboard.html path.

changelog.title: Core 2 Completion Stamps & Ch13 Link Fix
changelog.description: Completed chapters, labs, and quizzes now show diagonal COMPLETE stamp overlay on the Core 2 index page. Fixed broken Edition Selector tool link on Ch13.

changelog.title: Dark Gates Answer Leak Fix
changelog.description: Gate 6 and Gate 7 placeholders and answer options no longer give away correct answers. All options balanced in length and detail.

changelog.title: Save the Pod: Docker Container Rescue Game
changelog.description: Full interactive Docker game with 10 levels, boss fights every 10th level, infinite lapping with 8 color themes, combo scoring, and escalating complexity per lap.

changelog.title: WSA Challenges & Games Sidebar
changelog.description: Two-column layout with sticky sidebar featuring quick links, 4 interactive mini-games (PS Command Match, Port Master, Scenario Speed Run, Command Builder), and a localStorage leaderboard.

changelog.title: WSA Advanced Skills Gauntlet
changelog.description: Pre-capstone 135-objective gauntlet across 3 servers, 3 domains, 18 consoles, and 7 broken configs. The ultimate Windows Server challenge.

changelog.title: A+ Core 2 Navigation Fix
changelog.description: Presentations now return to course home instead of dashboard. Added Games & Challenges and Interactive Tools sections to course index.

changelog.title: ModuleProgress returnUrl
changelog.description: New returnUrl option in ModuleProgress.complete() allows modules to specify custom return destinations instead of always going to dashboard.

changelog.title: Centralized PSTerminal for All Labs
changelog.description: M08-M17 PS labs migrated from self-contained inline terminals to the shared PSTerminal.js component. One engine, 20 labs, zero drift.

changelog.title: 65+ New PowerShell Commands
changelog.description: PSTerminal.js expanded with DNS, DHCP, GPO, IIS, RDS, PKI, AD Replication, Backup, Firewall, and advanced networking command handlers.

changelog.title: Objective Callback System
changelog.description: PSTerminal.init() now accepts onObjectiveComplete callbacks, enabling labs to track task completion without onCommand polling.

changelog.title: Quiz Score Pipeline
changelog.description: Actual quiz scores (not just pass/fail) now flow through to the handler dashboard via Firestore analytics sync.

changelog.title: Two-Layer Progress Architecture
changelog.description: WSA course completions now flow through CourseProgress to the dashboard and Firestore. Handler dashboard sees real-time student progress.

changelog.title: PS-Error Gate
changelog.description: Failed PowerShell commands no longer count as completed objectives. Error detection gates added to M01 and M02 labs.

changelog.title: Piped Command Validation Fixed
changelog.description: Pipeline commands (Get-Service | Where-Object) now properly trigger objective completion in labs.

changelog.title: Dead Progress Writes Removed
changelog.description: Removed 43 orphaned hexworthProgress writes that were going nowhere. Clean Layer 1 pipeline only.

changelog.title: Analytics Sync Fixed
changelog.description: Student progress now syncs to Firestore in real-time. Instructor dashboard analytics fully operational.

changelog.title: EduScan Auto-Healing System
changelog.description: Content integrity enforcement tool with auto-fix capabilities. Detects and repairs broken paths, naming violations, and orphaned files.

changelog.title: 992 Files Standardized
changelog.description: All house content renamed to {house}-{name}.{type}.html convention. Consistent, discoverable, machine-parseable.

changelog.title: 237 Files Reorganized
changelog.description: Labs, quizzes, and tools moved to proper type directories. Clean separation by content type.

changelog.title: Full Rollback Capability
changelog.description: All renames and reorganizations can be undone with single commands. Safe experimentation.

changelog.title: GitHub Actions CI Pipeline
changelog.description: EduScan runs on every push/PR. Reports uploaded as artifacts, PR comments with issue summaries.

changelog.title: Content Health Dashboard
changelog.description: status.json generated on every scan. Critical/High/Medium/Low issue counts at a glance.

changelog.title: EduScan Documentation
changelog.description: Comprehensive README with CLI usage, fixer tools, issue codes, and architecture overview.

changelog.title: Zero Broken LearningPaths
changelog.description: All module hrefs now resolve to existing files. LP-001 count: 0.
